speaker_role: generic interview coach/test-prep marketer (Richard McMunn, former firefighter, runs 'passmyinterview.com'); not a college admissions specialist
commercial_incentive: Heavy — repeatedly directs viewers to purchase/download a full question-and-answer set from passmyinterview.com
key_insights: Provides fully scripted generic sample answers to 'tell me about yourself,' 'why this college,' 'what can you bring,' and 'biggest challenge' that are not tailored to any real applicant or school

Lists eight generic qualities colleges supposedly look for: positive attitude, researching the college, passion for subject, good written English, ability to work independently and in groups, an inquisitive mind, wise use of free time, and perseverance through challenges
Content and phrasing (references to 'lecturers,' 'coursework') suggest this targets UK further-education 'college' interviews rather than US undergraduate admissions
notable_or_distinctive: Nothing distinctive; entirely generic, memorized-sounding scripted answers with no admissions-specific insight.
reliability_notes: Extremely sales-driven (repeated calls to buy the full 19-question answer set); answers are robotic and generic; likely UK-context 'college' terminology rather than US higher-education admissions, limiting applicability to this research.
